snippet.title: SAMOPAL Protocol — Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A story-driven retro FPS set in 1960s Eastern Europe. 
Solo dev project.
Fight through industrial zones, the districts of a dead city and experimental areas to recover your memories and uncover the bloody truth of SAMOPAL Protocol.
